# Airbag / crash safety (ACSM) (0x01): value tables

<!-- Generated by tools/channel_docs.py from the catalogs. Do not edit. -->

What the numbers of enumerated channels mean. The app logs and charts the number and shows the text in the Status column.

## ACSM5.IMU_QUAL

| Value | Meaning | German |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | Signal valid | signal valid |
| 4 | Signal substituted | signal substituted |
| 6 | Signal invalid | signal invalid |
| 7 | Sensor missing | sensor missing |
| 8 | Init | Init |
| 15 | Invalid | Invalid |
